Class GTNetServerListImporter

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.gtnet.handler.GTNetServerListImporter
@Component public class GTNetServerListImporter extends Object
Merges a server list that a peer returned with GT_NET_UPDATE_SERVERLIST_ACCEPT_S into the local GTNet table.

The list arrives either in the synchronous reply envelope or as an inbound response of its own; both paths use this class so they cannot drift apart. A known server is updated when the peer's data is newer. An unknown server is always added: the list was requested by this instance, and an entry created from it carries neither a token nor an exchange grant, so nothing can be exchanged with it before a handshake. allowServerCreation of the own entry is therefore not consulted here; it only governs whether an unknown server may create its entry through a handshake.

    • importServerList

      public GTNetServerListImporter.ImportResult importServerList(GTNet myGTNet, String sourceDomain, tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode payload, tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper)
      Imports the server list carried in a payload.
      Parameters:
      myGTNet - the own GTNet entry, whose domain is skipped when it appears in the list
      sourceDomain - the domain of the peer that supplied the list, used for logging only
      payload - the payload holding a JSON array of GTNetPublicDTO; null or JSON null imports nothing
      objectMapper - the mapper that converts the payload
      Returns:
      the counts of what was added, updated and skipped
